sentences.en: My school is getting ready for the campus music festival.
sentences.zh: 我的学校正在为校园音乐节做准备。

sentences.en: The school does not allow students to smoke on campus.
sentences.zh: 学校不允许学生在校内吸烟。

sentences.en: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
sentences.zh: 我带他去了校园里最贵的餐馆。

senses.zh: （大学）校园；大学，大学生活；校园内的草地
